# pve_node_disk_directory (Resource)

Directory-formatted disk mounted via systemd unit on a node. Read filters the list endpoint on the underlying device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_directory" "example" {
  device = "CHANGE_ME"
  name   = "CHANGE_ME"
  node   = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) The block device you want to create the filesystem on.
- `name` (String) The storage identifier.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Configure storage using the directory. (default: 0)
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) Marks associated storage(s) as not available on this node anymore or removes them from the configuration (if configured for this node only). (default: 0)
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) Also wipe disk so it can be repurposed afterwards. (default: 0)
- `filesystem` (String) The desired filesystem. (default: ext4) One of: `ext4`, `xfs`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
